LanguageData.MouseDisaster_N004_SurvivedCaptivity.sta: I survived, but every day I have to do it all over again.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_N004_FamilySurvived.stages: My mother is still nearby. She did not leave today.
My child is still beside me. Nothing has taken them away yet.
My child is still beside me. Nothing has taken them away yet.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_N004_MotherRegret.stages.0: I keep returning to that day, wondering what I could have done differently.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_TailBitten.stages.0.label: My tail! I hate you!
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_TailBitten.stages.0.descri: My tail was bitten clean off. I will remember who did it for three days.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_TailBittenInjured.stages.0: Squeak! My tail hurts! You're just jealous that mine looks nicer.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_TailBiteSuccess.stages.0.d: Squeak! Mine's much longer now! So pretty! Yours is ugly.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_TailBiteFailed.stages.0.de: Squeak... I couldn't bite it off, and got hurt instead.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_TailCut.stages.0.label: Bleeding tail
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_TailCut.stages.0.descripti: My tail was cut. It keeps bleeding, and it hurts...
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_TailBruised.stages.0.label: Bruised tail
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_TailBruised.stages.0.descr: My tail is bruised all over. I hardly want to walk.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_EarTorn.stages.0.label: My ear is gone
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_EarTorn.stages.0.descripti: Squeak! My ear is gone! You're just jealous! Your ears are ugly.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_EarInjured.stages.0.label: My ear hurts
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_EarInjured.stages.0.descri: Squeak... my ear hurts... but it's still prettier than yours.

LanguageData.MouseDisaster_BeggingRejected.stages.0.d: I only wanted to survive, but they chased me off.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_OverGnawedWallThought.stag: I ate wall plaster. Was that really food?
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_SawBeggarRatkin_Kind.stage: Seeing hungry Ratkin beg for food made me feel awful.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_SawBeggarRatkin_Psychopath: Watching the Ratkin beg was strangely entertaining.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_BloodlineContinuation.stag: It does not matter whose child it is, as long as it is born.
Seeing the children safely born makes me happy.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_ChildExchangeFamilyMood.st: Mom and Dad took me out
Mom and Dad are right here. We're just going somewhere together.
They gave me to someone else, and now I am a prisoner.
They gave me to someone else, and now I am a prisoner. I never had parents to begin with.
They only brought me out for a little while. Nothing to be afraid of.
At last, someone let me stay alive. They gave me food, a bed and another chance.
